headline: Logistics and wholesale
prompt:
Create ONE finished premium educational presentation slide, landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. Match a consistent Agentic Founder series: Apple-inspired restraint, deep evergreen #142823 fading to near-black green, ivory/white text, restrained amber #F4B544 highlights, muted teal secondary details. Space Grotesk-like headings and Inter-like body. Large exceptionally legible exact English type, generous negative space, 6% safe margins. Polished friendly 3D objects with subtle studio lighting. No robots, money piles, wealth promises, or excessive glow. Exact discreet footer across bottom: left 'Data Science Masterminds', center 'Agentic Founder', right 'Kunaal Naik & Arpan Saxena'. All specified text must be spelled exactly. Do not add extra text. This teaches a business hypothesis, never guaranteed income.
Text-led CHAPTER INDEX, minimal illustration, large readable typography. Exact text:
CHAPTER 14
Logistics and wholesale
For people who understand freight records and operational exceptions.
AI-066  Proof-of-delivery document desk
AI-067  Freight invoice exception checker
AI-068  Customer shipment update drafts
AI-069  Warehouse training content kit
AI-070  Wholesale product-data translation
Choose one problem. Test one paid offer.
Use five generous rows with amber IDs and white titles. Tiny polished folder icon at right is enough. Do not crowd the content.
